model_annotation: This chart illustrates the negative log probability of per-specialty terms for Mistralv0.2-Base fine-tuned on various specialties. The horizontal axis lists the specialties being evaluated: Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics. The vertical axis represents the negative log probability, labeled and scaled linearly from -27 to -22. Each specialty evaluated has a group of bars representing different fine-tuning specialties, with distinct colors: Cardio (light peach), Gastro (peach), Infect (orange), Neuro (dark orange), Obstetrics (brown), and Pediatrics (dark brown). The Mistralv0.2-Base is represented by a light blue bar for reference. Approximate values for the bars range from -26.5 to -22.5, with the tallest light blue bar at around -26.5 for Cardio and the shortest dark brown bar at approximately -23 for Pediatrics; representative values include the light peach bar at around -24 for Infect and the orange bar at around -23.5 for Neuro. The bars are not sorted in a specific order within each group, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond color coding and the reference bar.
